info.title: Elmo Business OS API
info.description: ERP/CRM API for Business OS - Complete API Documentation including Authentication, Sales, Projects, Tasks, Client Portal, Admin Management, and Reporting

post.description: Authenticate user and return access token with profile information

List all quotations with pagination and filtering
Get active time entry for current user

post.summary: Start time tracking for an entity
post.description: Start a timer for a trackable entity (Lead, Quotation, or Task). First timer of the day triggers automatic clock-in.

400.description: Timer already active or invalid entity

get.summary: Get current user's attendance for today
get.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's attendance record for the current date, including active timer status and total worked minutes

post.description: Set clock_out time for today's attendance record and calculate idle minutes. Requires an existing attendance record for today.

404.description: No attendance record found for today

get.summary: List all projects with pagination and filtering
Get wiki entry details with decrypted content
Get all tasks with pagination and filtering
get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of tasks with optional filtering by project, status, assignee, and search

parameters.name: filter[assignedTo]
parameters.description: Filter tasks by assigned user ID

parameters.name: filter[parentId]
parameters.description: Filter tasks by parent ID (use null for root tasks)

post.description: Create a new task within a project

description.example: Add JWT-based authentication to the API

get.description: Retrieve a specific task by ID with related data

put.description: Update a task with status transition validation. Bug bounce rate tracked when status moves Testing -> In Progress.

delete.description: Delete a specific task by ID. Child tasks will also be deleted (cascade).

get.description: Retrieve all direct children of a specific task for lazy loading

get.summary: Get tasks for a project with hierarchy
get.description: Retrieve root-level tasks for a project with their children loaded

get.summary: Get all invoices with pagination and filtering
get.description: Admin endpoint to retrieve all invoices with optional filtering
Retrieve a paginated list of projects for the authenticated client with limited data visibility (Black Box principle)
Retrieve a specific project for the authenticated client with limited data visibility

post.summary: Approve UI/UX deliverables for client project
post.description: Allow client to approve UI/UX deliverables, transitioning project from ui_ux to development phase

400.description: Invalid operation - project not in UI/UX phase

post.description: Mark an invoice as paid for the authenticated client. Only payable invoices (sent or overdue status) can be paid.

400.description: Invalid operation - invoice cannot be paid in current status

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive dashboard statistics including profitability, quality metrics, and performance overview. Requires view_admin_stats permission.
Retrieve detailed profitability report for all projects with filtering and pagination. Requires both view_admin_stats AND view_internal_costs permissions.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Filter projects created from this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Filter projects created up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

get.summary: Get quality metrics including bounce rates
get.description: Retrieve comprehensive quality metrics including bounce rates by developer and top bouncing tasks. Requires view_admin_stats permission.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Filter data up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive user performance metrics including tracked time, idle time, task completion rates, and bounce rates. Requires view_admin_stats permission.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Filter data up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive attendance analytics including late arrivals, idle time statistics, and users with excessive idle time. Requires view_admin_stats permission.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Filter data up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

get.description: Retrieve all roles with their assigned permissions. Requires manage_roles permission.

post.description: Create a new role with specified permissions. Requires manage_roles permission.

permissions.description: Array of permission names to assign

get.description: Retrieve a specific role with its assigned permissions. Requires manage_roles permission.

put.description: Update role name and permissions. Cannot update protected roles (admin, client, super-admin). Requires manage_roles permission.

delete.description: Delete a role. Cannot delete protected roles (admin, client, super-admin). Requires manage_roles permission.

get.description: Retrieve all available permissions in the system. Requires manage_roles permission.

put.description: Update the internal hourly cost for a specific user. This endpoint requires manage_internal_costs permission and logs all changes to audit_logs. The actual cost value is never returned in the response for security.

internalHourlyCost.description: The internal hourly cost for the user (must be positive)

put.summary: Bulk update users' internal hourly costs
put.description: Update internal hourly costs for multiple users in a single operation. This endpoint requires manage_internal_costs permission and logs all changes to audit_logs. All costs are validated before any updates are made.

get.description: Retrieve all users with pagination, filtering, and sorting. Requires manage_users permission.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field (name, email, created_at). Prefix with - for descending

post.description: Create a new user with optional role assignment. Requires manage_users permission.

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific user. Requires manage_users permission.

put.description: Update user information. Requires manage_users permission.

delete.description: Delete a user. Cannot delete yourself. Requires manage_users permission.

post.description: Activate or deactivate a user. Requires manage_users permission.

put.description: Replace all user roles with the provided roles. Requires manage_users permission.

get.summary: Get audit logs with filtering and pagination
get.description: Retrieve audit logs with comprehensive filtering by action, user, date range, and resource ID search. Requires view_audit_logs permission.

parameters.name: filter[date_to]
parameters.description: Filter logs up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Search by resource ID or IP address

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by field (prefix with - for descending)
